wq3326ma.baseName: Walplus 50 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 125 cm
wq3326ma.variantName: Walplus 50 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 125 cm
wq3326ma.sourceDescription: This Pre-lit Artificial Christmas Tree elegantly captures the holiday spirit with its enchanting and seasonal presentation. Crafted for those who cherish decorative flair, its Art Deco-inspired design gleams with geometric precision, making it a stylish focal point in any space. Lightweight and portable, it effortlessly adorns both living rooms and terraces, creating a festive ambiance that invites joy and celebration. Materials: Made from durable PVC, this tree is designed to last through many holiday seasons. The material's resilience ensures it maintains a fresh look, resisting the wear that often accompanies annual decorations. An iron core structure provides stable support, ensuring the tree stands upright and secure, ready to be adorned with festive embellishments. Included Components: Featuring LED decorative string lights, this tree includes 8 flash modes to enhance its aura. The USB power source offers convenience, eliminating the need for traditional adapters and allowing for flexible placement. Ensure safe and efficient luminous displays with its thoughtfully designed LED elements. Features /Function /Design: With a pop-up design, the tree is quickly set up without fuss, efficiently creating a festive presence. The collapsible feature facilitates effortless storage post-holidays, reducing space constraints. Additionally, its transport-friendly nature allows relocation with minimal effort, adapting to various celebratory settings. Recommended Uses: Suitable for indoor and sheltered outdoor areas, this tree embellishes living rooms, gardens, and terraces with its festive charm. Its versatility aligns with personal gatherings or grand holiday affairs, suitably enhancing joyous occasions. Care &Maintenance: Maintain its lustrous appeal by avoiding the use of harsh chemicals and abrasives. Cleaning involves gentle dusting or wiping, ensuring it remains vibrant and inviting annual use. Product Specifications Colour: Green Material: PVC Tree height: 125 cm Bottom diameter: 40 cm Stand size: 36.5 cm Collapsible Light Weight Durable Portable Lifelike Decorate with ribbons,bows and flowers Pop-Up Number of baubles: 22 Lights type: Decorative string lights Lights color: Warm white Number of LEDs: 50 Distance between LEDs: 10 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Artificial Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x LED light string 1 x Pack of tree decoration DO NOT connect this chain electrically to another chain. The lamps are not replaceable. If product is used outdoors, the USB should be plugged in indoors, in dry environment. This item is not a toy and should be used for decorative purposes only. The product has a USB connector, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Please note to use only certified DC 5V input. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fire. The flexible cable of the string light cannot be replaced, and do not use the string light if the cable is damaged.Do not connect the LED lamp to the certified 5V USB power source while installing and maintaining. This appliance must not be used by children under 14 years and persons with reduced physical, sensory or mental capabilities or lack of experience and knowledge concerning the use of electronic appliances. Do not operate this product near explosives or flammable liquids, gases and dust. Do not operate the product in the extreme temperatures. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

gtpywe9e.baseName: Walplus 150 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree Wide Base - Green - 150 cm
gtpywe9e.variantName: Walplus 150 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree Wide Base - Green - 150 cm
gtpywe9e.sourceDescription: This elegant Artificial Christmas Tree blends modern style with traditional charm, featuring a sleek cone shape that enhances its visual appeal. Designed to be adorned with warm white decorative LED lights, it brings festive charm to any room or terrace, creating a cozy ambiance for the Christmas season. With a theme dedicated to Christmas, this tree is suitable for various holiday settings, providing a delightful focal point for indoor or outdoor decor. Its clean lines and minimal ornamentation complement contemporary living spaces while offering a functional holiday solution for families, event hosts, and festive enthusiasts. PVC and PE Materials: This tree is crafted from premium PE and PVC materials, ensuring both durability and an authentic look. These materials are known for being flame retardant, adding a layer of safety to your holiday setup. The tree maintains a vibrant green appearance without fading, providing an evergreen display that lasts all season. The combination of these materials brings realism to your festive decorations, offering a reliable and attractive solution for annual celebrations. Decorative LED String Lights: Equipped with warm white LED string lights, this tree illuminates your space with a gentle glow. The lights come with 8 flash modes, allowing you to adjust the lighting to fit your mood—whether you’re hosting a festive gathering or enjoying a silent night in. This lighting feature also enhances the tree’s ornamental value, making it a standout piece in your holiday décor. USB Power Source: This tree includes a USB power source, offering flexibility in where it can be displayed indoors or outdoors. The USB feature eliminates the need for traditional power outlets, making setup convenient and practical. It is an ideal choice for modern homes where power access is limited, ensuring the tree can be placed almost anywhere. Versatile Room Placement: Suitable for both indoor and outdoor spaces, this tree offers a versatile solution for holiday decorating. Whether it's in a living room corner, a garden patio, or a terrace, its adaptable size complements various environments and styles. The tree acts as a festive connector among friends and families during yearly seasonal celebrations. Care and Setup Instructions: Assembly requires two individuals for easy setup following the manufacturer’s instructions. Ensure proper placement and stability of the synthetic plastic stand for an upright and secure display throughout the holiday season. Its simple assembly process allows you to focus more on enjoying the festive period. Product Specifications Colour: Green Material: PE and PVC Tree height: 150 cm Bottom diameter: 75 cm Stand size: 35 cm Durable Lifelike tips Hinged Construction for Set up Foldable Stand Number of PVC tips: 150 Number of baubles: 61 Lights type: Decorative string lights Lights color: Warm white Lights length: 3000 cm Number of LEDs: 150 Distance between LEDs: 10 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Batteries Included: No Voltage: 5 V Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmastree 1 x Stand 1 x LED stringlight 1 x Peak 20 x 3 cm ball 21 x 4 cm ball 20 x 6 cm ball This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

rchfym72.variantName: Scottish Everlastings Artificial Candy Cane Wreath - 55cm
rchfym72.sourceDescription: Add a cheerful festive touch to your home with this artificial 55cm candy cane wreath. Designed with a playful red and white striped theme, it brings a joyful burst of colour and classic Christmas charm to any door, wall or interior display. The carefully arranged foliage provides a full and balanced shape, creating a natural looking base that beautifully showcases the iconic candy cane detailing. Its vibrant design captures the spirit of the season, making it a perfect choice for both traditional and contemporary festive décor schemes. Compact yet impactful at 55cm, this wreath is ideal for smaller spaces or for layering with other seasonal decorations. It pairs effortlessly with fairy lights, garlands and baubles to create a coordinated and eye catching festive look throughout your home. Durable and designed for repeated use, this candy cane wreath offers a fun and stylish way to brighten your Christmas celebrations year after year. Bring indoors during adverse weather conditions. Wreath Width: W55cm. Wipe clean with a soft cloth. Materials: Plastic, polyester, twig, wire, foam. Bring indoors in adverse weather conditions SEL UK Ltd Frances Industrial Park, Wemyss Road, Kirkcaldy KY12XZ
